newsitem.title: CANADA: N.E.T. to use Memotec frame relays.
newsitem.headline: N.E.T. to use Memotec frame relays.

text.p: Memotec Communications Inc said on Tuesday that California-based N.E.T. agreed to incorporate Memotec's frame relay products in the N.E.T. FrameXpress product family.

The result will be more comprehensive N.E.T. frame relay solutions, including SNA traffic and voice-over-frame support for access to both enterprise backbone networks and public frame relay services, Memotec said.

Under the agreement, N.E.T. will market, sell, service and support the Memotec frame relay products as an integral part the N.E.T. FrameXpress product line thorugh N.E.T. direct and selected distribution channels on a worldwide basis to enterprise clients and network service providers, Memotec said.
The two companies have begun discussions related to a technology exchange to potentially enhance interoperability and manageability, Memotec said.
